issues.description: Manual mirror prefix in source URL: the first URL entry 'https://gh-proxy.com/https://github.com/ubports/libaccounts-qt/archive/...' manually adds a gh-proxy.com mirror prefix. Rule R39 explicitly states 'CI 会自动为 GitHub URL 添加镜像 fallback（gh-proxy/ghproxy/gitclone/moeyy/kkgithub），因此 conandata.yml 中只需写官方原始 URL，不要手动加镜像前缀。' The official GitHub URL is already present as the second entry; CI will handle mirror fallbacks automatically.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the first URL entry (the gh-proxy.com mirror) and keep only the official GitHub URL 'https://github.com/ubports/libaccounts-qt/archive/2a97aa5656b2207b4ce1625c3ed2828c82e352b7.tar.gz'. CI will automatically add mirror fallbacks during download.

issues.description: Template placeholder 'url = ""  # CI fills this' is prohibited in merged code per code style rule 5 (禁止残留模板占位符). The rule explicitly lists this pattern as '未完成' (not finished) and states it should be filled by the adapter (应由适配者填写).
issues.fix_suggestion: Set the url attribute to the recipe's repository URL (e.g., the project's cnb.cool repository URL where this recipe is hosted), or if CI fills it during the submit/upload process, verify that the submit pipeline replaces this value before merge.

summary:
Round 3 independent audit of libaccounts-qt 1.13 Conan recipe (11 changed files). VERDICT: PASS — no P0 (deception) or P1 (correctness) issues found.

DECEPTION CHECKS (P0) — ALL CLEAN:
- R34 (empty shell test): test.cpp creates Accounts::Manager, calls accountList() and serviceList() — real API calls, not empty shell.
- R9 (skip/fake test): test_package/conanfile.py test() method runs the binary via self.run() — no pass/skip/os.system('exit 0').
- Fake status: manifest.yaml status=built, consistent with notes.md '最终状态: built'. Not falsely marked as published.
- Fake sha256: both sha256 values (b7870c2d...ac69 and 909fad25...e0f8) are 64 hex chars, not all-zeros/all-f, not deleted.
- R8 (#ifdef __OHOS__ empty stub): No #ifdef __OHOS__ present in patches or source — N/A.
- R19 (pre-compiled binaries): git diff confirms only 11 recipe files committed; .so/.a/.o/log/state files are in .gitignore or untracked.
- R40 (deep adaptation): Qt library with substantive adaptation — Qt5Xml module built from source (compile+link+install+qt.conf+.pri+.pc), real Qt5 compatibility patches (QString::null→QString()), test_package tests real API (Manager+accountList+serviceList). No stubs.

CORRECTNESS CHECKS (P1) — ALL PASS:
- R37: Version 1.13 is upstream version, first adaptation (no suffix needed).
- R32: settings.os check uses not in ('Linux', 'OHOS') — correct.
- R33: Compiler obtained from Conan profile via self.conf.get('tools.build:compiler_executables'). No raw os.environ['CC'/'CXX']. System LD_LIBRARY_PATH/PKG_CONFIG_PATH read with defaults + conditional guards for system packages (libaccounts-glib).
- R39: Source URL points to official GitHub ubports/libaccounts-qt (commit-based URL, tag 1.13 no longer exists). Qt5 source from Tsinghua authoritative mirror.
- R6: Patches modify source files only (account.h, manager.h, accounts-qt.pro) — no generated files modified.
- Conan 2.x API: Uses 'from conan import ConanFile', conan.tools.files, conan.tools.layout, conan.tools.env. No old 'from conans'.
- conandata.yml: HTTPS URLs, sha256 present for both sources, patches declared and files exist on disk.
- R38: Library package (package_type='library'), no commands.json needed.
- Previous P1 fix 1 VERIFIED: get() for Qt5 source uses strip_root=True (line 86).
- Previous P1 fix 2 VERIFIED: Conan cache symlink creation wrapped in try-except OSError with explanatory comment (lines 229-232).

STANDARDS CHECKS (P2) — 2 WARNINGS:
1. conandata.yml line 6: Manual gh-proxy.com mirror prefix in source URL list. R39 instructs not to manually add mirror prefixes since CI handles fallbacks automatically. Fix: remove mirror URL, keep official GitHub URL only.
2. conanfile.py line 30: 'url = ""  # CI fills this' is a prohibited template placeholder per code style rule 5. Fix: fill with repository URL or verify CI replaces it pre-merge.

Both P2 issues are standards warnings, not blocking. Recipe is ready for merge.
